mapper.sql: id, actor_username, action, route_id, before_json, after_json, ip, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (actor_username, action, route_id, before_json, after_json, ip, created_at) VALUES (#{actorUsername}, #{action}, #{routeId}, #{beforeJson}, #{afterJson}, #{ip}, #{createdAt})
